change_summary: Replaced only the `retrieve_sources` boundary. The retrieval method now uses bounded, per-plan source budgets; prioritizes source-native practitioner evidence; avoids repeated URL processing before expensive fetches; uses HN item-thread context instead of arbitrary linked-page scraping; and records clearer retrieval gaps without hiding failures.
